add_definitions(-DDEBUG)

# storahci.c replaced by Rust (storahci-rust). AHCI storport miniport; links storport.
# Stays DISABLED from shipping (re-enable when AHCI is wired) -> built + link-clean x3 only.

#add_cd_file(TARGET storahci DESTINATION reactos/system32/drivers NO_CAB FOR all)
#add_driver_inf(storahci storahci.inf)

# storahci.sys is all Rust (storahci-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/storahci-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(storahci_res OBJECT storahci.rc)
target_include_directories(storahci_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
add_cargo_module(storahci storahci-cargo storahci.sys
    KIND kernelmodedriver
    BODY_CRATE storahci-rust
    NO_CD
    EXTRA_DEPENDS storahci_res psdk)
